# Mochi

Original cat artwork generated with the built-in imagegen tool, using the user's supplied Codex pet screenshot as a style reference. The human character was not reused. The PNG has a transparent alpha channel and a 4 by 4 sprite grid. The website crops cells in CSS; the generated PNG is preserved unchanged.

Frames, left to right: idle/blink/walk/walk; pet/wave/crouch/jump; play/play/sleep/sleep; feed/lick/look/look.

Generation prompt: Create a uniform 4 by 4 transparent sprite sheet of one consistent ginger tabby cat, imitating the reference's warm retro pixel-art shading, dark outlines and chibi proportions. Cream muzzle, chest and paws; amber eyes; teal collar with a gold bell; fluffy striped tail. Full body in every cell, matching scale and feet baseline. Frames are idle, blink, two walking steps, happy petting, paw wave with hearts, crouch, jump, two yarn-ball play poses, two curled sleeping poses, sniffing fish, licking mouth, and two curious sitting poses. No human character, labels, grid lines, background or watermark.
